e: Nauru inaugurates its first Israeli embassy in Jerusalem.
Nauru changes its official name to the Republic of Naoero, which matches the spelling and pronunciation of the Nauruan language.
The Nauruan government revokes its recognition of the independence of Abkhazia and South Ossetia.
The Parliament of Nauru passes a constitutional amendment to change the name of the country to Naoero.
Lionel Aingimea is sworn in as the first Vice President of Nauru.
Parliament unanimously passes a constitutional amendment to extend the parliamentary term from 3 to 4 years after the amendment failed to pass via referendum in October 2025.
